map.未来现金流 100 万、折现系数 0.75（对应折现率与年限） → 现值=100: Future cash flow of 1 million yuan at a discount factor of 0.75 (set by the rate and horizon) gives a present value of 100 × 0.75 = 750,000; in cost mode this tool outputs total = A × B.
map.若 3 期现金流各 100 万、现值系数 0.95/0.90/0.86 → 现值: With three periods of 1 million yuan each at factors of 0.95/0.90/0.86, total present value = 100 × (0.95 + 0.90 + 0.86) = 2.71 million; the further out the period, the lower the present value.
map.折现率怎么定？: How is the discount rate set?
map.用项目要求回报率或 WACC，风险越高折现率越高，远期现金流折损越大。: Use the project's required return or WACC; higher risk means a higher rate and heavier discounting of distant cash flows.
map.现值越大越好吗？: Is a larger present value always better?
map.在投入固定时现值是，但要看现值与投入的差（NPV），NPV>0 才创造价值。: With the outlay fixed, yes, but look at the difference between present value and outlay (NPV); only a positive NPV creates value.

map.折现现值（本页代码口径，生效版仅三档单现金流）：r=折现率%÷100；1 年现值: Discounted present value (as coded on this page; the final version covers only three single-cash-flow horizons): r = discount rate%÷100; 1-year PV = CF÷(1+r), 5-year PV = CF÷(1+r)⁵, 10-year PV = CF÷(1+r)¹⁰; 10-year discount loss = CF−10-year PV (yuan). Validation: both fields must be finite, otherwise the page asks for two valid numbers and stops (there is no hard check that r>0). Verdict: no fixed grading; a higher r means a lower PV, and at r=0 all three horizons equal CF with zero discount loss.
